title: Anthropic's Claude claws its way towards the top of AI chart • The Register
summary: Anthropic's business subscriptions for AI models Claude grew significantly, partly due to competition with OpenAI, amidst a Defense Department controversy and public endorsements. OpenAI's share declined as it faced criticism for its handling of Pentagon relations and strategic shifts.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is negative due to the Defense Department controversy, public disagreements, and the negative market reaction to OpenAI's strategic decisions.
